name: Fungal Surge
body:
School: transmutation; Level fungomancer 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You infuse your body with fungal energy, enhancing your physical abilities. You gain a +4 enhancement bonus to your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score (your choice when you cast the spell).
